title: Evaluation of a product circuit
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $x$ assign an element of $R$ to each of $n$ inputs, and let $k$ be a natural number. In the successive evaluation of the circuit built to compute the product of the first $k$ factors, the value at index $0$ (taken to be $0$ if that index is absent) is $1$, and the value at index $3k$ (again taken to be $0$ if absent) is $\prod_{i=0}^{k-1}(1+v_i)$, where $v_i=x_i$ if $i<n$ and $v_i=1$ otherwise.
